lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Plate A to strip B fold of about 88 deg, present only across the ~8.5 mm neck between the two relief notches. Perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% on the dense mesh put the label point 0.04/0.01/0.01 mm from the bottom of the outer-skin arc. A 0.1 mm sweep finds apex material from t=0.05 to 8.15 mm on the 8.4 mm line, so it covers the fold fully and overshoots by about 0.25 mm. Beyond both ends the sections show only the slot edge and A's free edge. Line is parallel to the fold.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Strip B to tab fold of about 89 deg. Sections at 25/50/75% put the label point 0.02/0.01/0.06 mm from the outer apex. The fold runs from t=-0.2 to 10.9 mm (11.1 mm) and the line runs 0 to 10.64 mm, so it covers about 96% at full strip width. Line is parallel. The relief notch on the strip edge and the formed hole collar are not bends.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Tab to end-lip fold of about 83 deg, bent the opposite way to B2 (Z profile), and clearly formed in the face-on, inside and oblique close-ups. Sections at 25/50/75% put the label point 0.06/0.03/0.05 mm from the outer apex. The fold runs from t=-0.15 to 3.9 mm (about 4.05 mm) and the 3.70 mm line sits inside it, so it covers about 91%, above the 80% minimum.
